subject: Pilot economics check-in and request for short credit top-up
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@datashade.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot economics check-in + next steps

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can keep the pilot momentum going: 

- Observations from our side: the sandbox workload you sent shows bursty batch scoring peaks (short 10–20 minute windows at ~2–3M tokens/hour) and a lower steady-state of ~200–300k tokens/hour.
- Clarify monthly target: you mentioned a range — is DataShade planning for ~8–12M tokens/mo (early production) or should we model for 18–25M tokens/mo (rapid rollout)?
- Budget target: you indicated a target unit economics in the ballpark of $800–$1,000 per 1M tokens. Can you confirm the internal budget range (monthly)?
- Pilot ask: your current temporary credits will exhaust in ~4 days at the present burn. Would you like Redwood to provision a short top-up to avoid interruption while we finalize pricing? If yes, what duration/size would you like (we typically offer one-off top-ups in token amounts; common requests are 500k–2M tokens).

Attachments: datashade-token-breakdown.csv (sample hourly profile you shared)

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm expected monthly token band and target $/1M tokens.
2) If you want the top-up, reply with the requested token amount and procurement contact.
3) We schedule a technical deep-dive with Monica (platform architect) to go over caching/batching knobs that will materially improve your unit economics.

Happy to jump on a short call tomorrow if that helps.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Elena Morales <elena@datashade.ai>

Cc: DataShade Procurement <procurement@datashade.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot economics check-in + next steps

Alex — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications below (quoting your bullets):

> - Monthly target: we expect to peak quickly once we flip a few customers on. Realistically planning for 10–15M tokens/mo in month 1 of production, but we want pricing that scales if we hit 20M+.
> - Budget target: target unit cost is roughly $850/1M tokens; finance gave us a target cap of $12k/mo for the pilot/proof window but can stretch to $15k with exec approval.

For the top-up: we do want a one-off extension to avoid the interruption you flagged. Requesting 1.5M token credit (two-week runway) so we can run the integration tests and a small customer smoke test. Procurement contact is procurement@datashade.ai — they handle statements and PO.

I attached an updated hourly breakdown for the smoke tests and some notes on the batch scoring cadence. If you can temporarily provision the 1.5M token credit and confirm the exact token accounting, that would be great. Also, Monica’s deep-dive sounds useful — Tues/Wed next week is best for our infra lead.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of ML Product, DataShade
elena@datashade.ai
